body:
## What to build

Preserve ordinary empty-dots forwarding when fixed-key selectors or Grouping specification constructors receive a valid tidyselect helper argument. A reusable wrapper called without optional columns must resolve an empty selection or report the constructor's documented empty-dimension refusal, rather than failing in an internal classifier.

On main `978d7bef4247bf1348af5b90bfab47924db25500`, a one-row input with one column is enough. Define a wrapper with `...` that calls `inspect_grouping()` using `all_of(c(...))` as `.by`, then call that wrapper with no arguments. It raises `getvarError: argument "value" is missing, with no default` from an internal iterator. Direct tidyselect evaluation in that same wrapper returns an empty selection. Supplying a column name also succeeds. The equivalent selector inside `grouping_set()` fails in the same way, as do both nesting Margin verbs.

The finite matrix compared 360 public calls: 120 empty-dots classifier failures and 240 populated-dots or whole-helper-wrapper controls that succeeded or raised the required empty rollup/cube Package condition. It covered `all_of` and `any_of`, concatenated and unlisted dots, fixed-key position and all five constructors, inspection and all four Margin verbs. Wrapping the whole helper with `identity()` avoided the defective names-only classification. An independent public-seam reproduction confirmed six inspect/nesting failures and their successful populated controls.

The failure was independently reached in the names-only helper-argument reader on the empty `...` symbol, before actual selection resolution. This differs from #1138, whose populated local summary selectors lose their forwarding environment when raw quoted arguments are staged. Full bodies/comments of #1138, #351, #925, #1139 and PR #1142 were checked, along with all-state issue/PR searches; none reported this empty-dots Grouping classifier boundary. The repairs are independently verifiable and neither blocks the other.

Tested with R 4.6.1, dplyr 1.2.1, tidyselect 1.2.1 and rlang 1.3.0.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The demonstrated empty-dots fixed-key and constructor selectors agree with direct tidyselect selection through inspection and both nesting verbs, and through the shared expansion/summary consumers.
- [ ] An empty selection yields the correct empty grouping set where allowed; empty rollup/cube dimensions retain their documented Package conditions.
- [ ] Preserve populated forwarding, concatenated/unlisted dots, the successful whole-helper wrapper control, captured environments and ordinary evaluation budgets.
- [ ] Do not force missing dots into a local value or execute caller selectors during static names-only classification merely to discover their selection.
- [ ] Add focused public-seam regression coverage that distinguishes no dots from an explicitly missing argument and from the populated summary-forwarding boundary in #1138.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately).

title: [P2] Preserve empty dots forwarding in Grouping selectors
